reviewMethod: Sequential contact-frame visual inspection, extractor/alpha inspection and generated animation previews; runtime verification recorded separately.

down45_idle.review: Four-frame contact sequence inspected for stable identity, complete anatomy and readable pose progression. Gentle breathing/blink; subtle motion is intentional.

down45_hop.review: Four-frame contact sequence inspected for stable identity, complete anatomy and readable pose progression. Bounding crouch/lift/settle/return; this is a hop cycle, not a walk/run claim.

down45_attack.review: Four-frame contact sequence inspected for stable identity, complete anatomy and readable pose progression. Wind-up, contact and recovery read in order.

down45_hit.review: Four-frame contact sequence inspected for stable identity, complete anatomy and readable pose progression. Brief recoil returns to the ready pose.

down45_death.review: Four-frame contact sequence inspected for stable identity, complete anatomy and readable pose progression. Collapse ends on the ground and does not stand back up.

up45_idle.review: Four-frame contact sequence inspected for stable identity, complete anatomy and readable pose progression. Gentle breathing/blink; subtle motion is intentional.

up45_hop.review: Four-frame contact sequence inspected for stable identity, complete anatomy and readable pose progression. Bounding crouch/lift/settle/return; this is a hop cycle, not a walk/run claim.

up45_attack.review: Four-frame contact sequence inspected for stable identity, complete anatomy and readable pose progression. Wind-up, contact and recovery read in order.

up45_hit.review: Four-frame contact sequence inspected for stable identity, complete anatomy and readable pose progression. Brief recoil returns to the ready pose.

limitations: Four authored poses per motion; bounding movement, not full walking strides.
Left directions are mirrored from the declared symmetric design.
